description: Index vs single-name implied correlation and realized correlation across a user-supplied basket. Returns correlation premium (implied minus realized), dispersion trade setup, implied vol of the index vs basket, and per-constituent vol contribution. Use for dispersion trading, correlation premium sizing, or cross-asset vol arb. Alpha tier required.

apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key. Omit when calling via /mcp-oauth (OAuth flow); required on /mcp.

horizon_days.description: Optional lookback window in days for realized correlation (default 20, clamped to 5-252).

index.description: Index symbol whose ATM IV anchors the implied correlation (e.g. SPX, NDX, RUT)

weights.description: Optional comma-separated weights matching symbols order. Defaults to equal weight.

name: get_dispersion
title: Dispersion / Correlation
